_about: The simulated world: shoppers, orders, networks, card schemes, claimants, a support person and two model stand-ins. Only src of the world module reads this file. Rates are per order, per claim or per read as named.

networks._about: trackingLoss: share of orders whose tracking breaks (blocked cookies, app switches). reportHoursMax stays below every claimAfterDays, as the terms promise.

delivery._about: How events reach us: delays, duplicates and whole-history replays.

claims._about: Who files a missing-cashback claim, and when. Days after the order follow an exponential with the mean, from the minimum.

reader._about: The model stand-in that reads confirmations. Errors are drawn per claim and attempt. Hard documents (bad scans, mangled pastes) misread far more often.

judge._about: The model alone deciding claims: how often it gets each kind of claim wrong.

person._about: A support person deciding a claim with all the evidence in front of them.
